groups.name: Centered fixed-width content container
groups.definition: Is the main content constrained to a centered fixed-width container narrower than the viewport with side margins?

groups.name: Container with full-bleed breakout sections
groups.definition: Does content sit in a centered container while hero, photo or color bands run full-bleed to the page edge?

groups.name: Uses both CSS grid and flexbox
groups.definition: Does the layout combine CSS grid and flexbox containers (without one clearly dominating)?

groups.name: Grid dominates over flexbox
groups.definition: Does the layout rely mainly on CSS grid rather than flexbox?

groups.name: Flexbox dominates over grid
groups.definition: Does the layout rely mainly on flexbox with few grid containers?

groups.name: Little grid or flex, simple block flow
groups.definition: Does the page use almost no grid or flex, relying on simple stacked block flow?

groups.name: Alternating section background bands
groups.definition: Do full-width section backgrounds alternate between colors (e.g. white and a tint) to separate content bands?

groups.name: Centered intro with single CTA
groups.definition: Is there a minimal centered section with a heading, short text and a single call-to-action button?

groups.name: Alternating image-text split rows
groups.definition: Do image-and-text rows alternate which side the image sits on?

groups.name: Two-column split section, image and text
groups.definition: Is there a two-column split section with an image or photo on one side and text/CTA on the other?

groups.name: Two-column hero with image or form
groups.definition: Is the hero a two-column split with text on one side and an image, photo, form or cards on the other?

groups.name: Left-aligned hero text block
groups.definition: Is the hero content left-aligned with a large headline, optional subtitle and a button or tagline?

groups.name: Text-only hero without photo
groups.definition: Is the hero text-only with no photograph or imagery?

groups.name: Hero with stats row and pill CTA
groups.definition: Does the hero show headline, muted description and stats row with a pill CTA on the right?

groups.name: Text-only sections with eyebrow and button
groups.definition: Are there text-only sections with eyebrow, short heading, subline and button and no imagery?

groups.name: Split section with text left, list or cards right
groups.definition: Is there a two-column section pairing heading/intro text with a list or card grid on the other side?

groups.name: Three-column card grid
groups.definition: Are cards arranged in a three-column row/grid?

groups.name: Four-column grid with empty last row
groups.definition: Is there a four-column card grid with incomplete rows leaving empty columns?

groups.name: Uneven card heights in a row
groups.definition: Do cards in a row have uneven heights leaving blank space beneath shorter ones?

groups.name: Equal-height cards in a row
groups.definition: Do cards in a row stretch to equal height regardless of text length?

groups.name: Main column with side sidebar
groups.definition: Does the layout have a main content column beside a narrower sidebar?

groups.name: Multi-column gallery or thumbnail grid
groups.definition: Is there a multi-column grid of image thumbnails in framed tiles?

groups.name: Three-part header with centered element
groups.definition: Is the header split into left, centered and right parts?

groups.name: Header with logo left and nav right
groups.definition: Is the header a bar with logo at left and navigation links (possibly with CTA, dropdowns or utilities) at right?

groups.name: Multi-column dark footer
groups.definition: Is the footer a dark multi-column block of links and headings?

groups.name: Footer with divider and bottom row
groups.definition: Does the footer have a thin divider above a bottom row with copyright/legal links and other items?

groups.name: Light or two-column contact footer
groups.definition: Is the footer or contact area a light/white two-column block with contact or social details?

groups.name: Mixed alignment and shifting edges
groups.definition: Do alignment edges, heading alignment and container widths shift between sections rather than following one grid?

groups.name: Tiles anchored text and edge-to-edge
groups.definition: Do split tiles run edge to edge with text anchored at the bottom left?

groups.name: Narrow paragraph measure leaving empty side
groups.definition: Are prose paragraphs or intro text constrained to a narrower width than the container, leaving the other side empty?

groups.name: Section header with eyebrow or split subtitle
groups.definition: Do section headers use an eyebrow label or place heading and subtitle on a split row?

groups.name: Generous vertical section spacing
groups.definition: Is there generous vertical padding between sections?

groups.name: Long vertically stacked page
groups.definition: Is the page long, spanning several viewport heights with many sequential sections or entries?

groups.name: Link-dense page
groups.definition: Does the page have many anchors and list items relative to body text?

groups.name: Media section with large thumbnail and list
groups.definition: Does a section pair one large video/image thumbnail with a stacked list of smaller cards?

groups.name: Side-by-side secondary sections
groups.definition: Do secondary sections sit side by side in two columns?

groups.name: Stacked FAQ cards in narrow column
groups.definition: Is FAQ content shown as stacked expanded cards in a narrow centered column?
